summary: Update the Color Match frontend toolchain and stabilize browser-back readiness coverage

spec.reason: The dependency update and test-only readiness synchronization do not change matching rules, controls, persistence, or release behavior.

design.reason: No visual assets, layout, copy, or interaction design are changed by the toolchain or test update.

validation: Installed the exact lockfile with npm ci, then passed lint with three pre-existing unused-symbol warnings and no errors, typecheck, all 33 unit tests, and the production build on Windows.

The browser-back E2E now waits for each visit to reach the playable title phase before navigating or starting play, preventing expected in-flight blob cancellations from hiding real page, console, or request failures.
The pull request must also pass its unchanged Chromium and WebKit browser workflows after it is updated onto the final integration base.
limitations: Physical-device and external portal checks are not applicable to this dependency-only change and were not repeated.

npm audit still reports the pre-existing transitive development dependency brace-expansion 5.0.9 advisory; this pull request neither introduces nor resolves it, and no forceful audit rewrite was applied.
